BiblicalUsage: The fire had no power upon the bodies of the three men, nor was a hair of their head singed, neither were their coats changed, nor the smell of fire had passed on them.
TheologicalSignificance: What this leaves me with is that the God who keeps the smell of fire off His servants is the God who keeps His servants in the fire.
Sources: Strong's Exhaustive Concordance (1890), via OpenScriptures Strong's Dictionary (CC BY-SA)
